prompt: You use prompt caching with a long system prompt and several tools. Mid-session your code edits the description of one tool. What happens to the cache?

options.text: Only the edited tool's entry is invalidated.
Nothing; tool definitions are not part of the cached prefix.
Only the message cache is invalidated.
The whole cache is invalidated, because the prefix is ordered tools, then system, then messages.

explanation: Caching works on prompt prefixes in the order tools, system, messages. A change at one level invalidates that level and everything after it, and modifying tool definitions (names, descriptions, parameters) invalidates the entire cache.
